contexts.text: She was buried below Bethel under the oak () = rejected for ever. For under the oak = for ever; and below Bethel = outside of the Natural; for what is said to be below, or beneath = without or outside of. Explained.
Under the hand () = for disposal in every necessity.

They put it under him () = correspondence with truth which is in the first of order. Explained. (The stone = truth in the ultimate of order, because it was put under him, and he sat upon it. AC 8609.)
All that extense which is under the Sun is called the natural world.
They think they are not under this law.
Under the earth () = in the lower Heavens. Explained.
We will stand perpendicularly under you...
